item.title: Codex Memory: AGENTS.md, Memories and Add-ons
item.description:
Codex memory is two built-in layers. AGENTS.md files hold instructions you write, and Codex loads them at the start of every run. Codex memories, off by default, turn useful context from past chats into local files under ~/.codex/memories/. For memory that is searchable, shared across agents or kept on a server, add a hook-based plugin such as Hindsight.

Codex is OpenAI’s coding agent for the terminal, IDE and ChatGPT desktop app. Each session starts with an empty context window, so anything Codex should know must come back in from a file or a tool. Facts below come from OpenAI’s Codex memories docs and AGENTS.md guide, checked 13 October 2026. For Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot, see AI coding agent memory.
